new_task_1.title: Name the offending fixture when @pytest.fixture is applied twice
new_task_1.description: Pytest 8.0.1 improves duplicate fixture-decorator validation so applying `@pytest.fixture` more than once to the same function still raises an error, but now identifies the offending fixture function by name in the failure message.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that pytest reports which fixture function is invalid when `@pytest.fixture` is applied more than once to the same function.

expectation.grounded: When pytest encounters a function that has been decorated with `@pytest.fixture` multiple times, it must continue to raise `ValueError` during fixture processing, and the error message must include the affected function name, formatted as `@pytest.fixture is being applied more than once to the same function 'name'`.
expectation.conceptual: Invalid duplicate fixture decoration should fail with a precise diagnostic that tells users exactly which fixture definition caused the problem, instead of a generic message with no fixture identity.

constraints.grounded: This change is limited to the duplicate-decoration validation path. It must not alter how valid fixture declarations behave, and it must not change the fact that duplicate application remains an error.
constraints.conceptual: The upgrade should improve diagnostics only. It should not introduce new fixture semantics or relax the existing validation rule.

behavior: Applying `@pytest.fixture` more than once to the same function still fails during pytest processing.
The resulting `ValueError` now names the offending fixture function.
Correctly declared fixtures with a single `@pytest.fixture` decorator continue to behave the same as before.
acceptance_criteria: When a fixture function is decorated with `@pytest.fixture` twice, running pytest should produce a collection error rather than silently accepting the declaration.
The raised error should be a `ValueError` whose message includes the fixture function name in the duplicate-decoration diagnostic.
When a fixture function is decorated correctly only once, pytest should continue processing it without this error.
